capabilities: Enter Morse code in a draggable floating window
Translate Morse input to text in real time
Insert decoded text manually or automatically after typing stops
Customize dot and dash characters and output case
Open and close the translator via commands and hotkeys
extras: Manual installation only; works only in Live Preview or Source mode, not Reading Mode; bilingual Chinese/English interface.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type Morse code and convert it to text while editing a note.
summary: Floating-window Morse code translator that decodes Morse input in real time and inserts the text into the current note.
